events.title: Oswiu of Northumbria defeats and kills Penda of Mercia at the Winwaed
events.description: At the Winwaed, probably near Leeds, Oswiu of Northumbria defeated and killed the pagan King Penda of Mercia, and many of Penda's allied kings also died. According to Bede, the battle marked the effective end of Anglo-Saxon paganism.

events.title: Swiss confederates ambush the Habsburgs at Morgarten
events.description: Men of Schwyz, Uri and Unterwalden ambushed Duke Leopold of Austria's army on a narrow path by Lake Ägeri. The victory strengthened the young Swiss Confederation.
events.html: Men of Schwyz, Uri and Unterwalden ambushed Duke Leopold of Austria's army on a narrow path by Lake Ägeri. The victory strengthened the young Swiss Confederation.

events.title: Francisco Pizarro's Spaniards enter Cusco, the Inca capital
events.description: Spanish forces under Francisco Pizarro entered Cusco, the capital of the Inca Empire, sealing their conquest of Peru. The Spaniards later rebuilt its palaces and temples, including the Coricancha, on Inca foundations.
events.html: Spanish forces under Francisco Pizarro entered Cusco, the capital of the Inca Empire, sealing their conquest of Peru. The Spaniards later rebuilt its palaces and temples, including the Coricancha, on Inca foundations.

events.title: Habsburg and Danish forces defeat the Kuruc army at Zsibó
events.description: Forces of the Habsburg Empire, Denmark-Norway and Vojvodian Serbs defeated the Kuruc army of Francis II Rákóczi at Zsibó in Transylvania. Flanked by the Austrian cavalry, the Hungarians were forced to retreat.
events.html: Forces of the Habsburg Empire, Denmark-Norway and Vojvodian Serbs defeated the Kuruc army of Francis II Rákóczi at Zsibó in Transylvania. Flanked by the Austrian cavalry, the Hungarians were forced to retreat.

events.title: Congress adopts the Articles of Confederation
events.description: The Continental Congress approved the Articles of Confederation, the first constitution of the United States. Ratified in 1781, they gave the central government too little power and were replaced in 1789.
events.html: The Continental Congress approved the Articles of Confederation, the first constitution of the United States. Ratified in 1781, they gave the central government too little power and were replaced in 1789.

events.title: Sherman leaves Atlanta on his March to the Sea
events.description: After burning much of Atlanta, William T. Sherman's army set off for Savannah. Its destruction of railways, crops and property across Georgia aimed to break the Confederacy's capacity and will to fight.

events.title: A military coup makes Brazil a republic
events.description: Marshal Deodoro da Fonseca led a coup in Rio de Janeiro that deposed Emperor Pedro II and proclaimed the Republic of Brazil. The 64-year-old emperor went into exile in Europe.
events.html: Marshal Deodoro da Fonseca led a coup in Rio de Janeiro that deposed Emperor Pedro II and proclaimed the Republic of Brazil. The 64-year-old emperor went into exile in Europe.

events.title: The League of Nations holds its first Assembly
events.description: Delegates of 41 nations met in Geneva for the first Assembly of the League of Nations. Weakened by the absence of the United States, the League failed to prevent the aggression of the 1930s.
